verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions building custom dashboards. It documents LLM tracing, evaluation submission, managed and custom evaluators, and agent usage/cost analysis in Agent Console, but none of these is shown as user-configurable dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics. Adjacent features like evaluations attached to spans and APM correlation do not earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can build custom dashboards over latency, error, cost, and eval-score metrics
